# fortiappseccloud_waf_http_header_security

Configures HTTP header security for one FortiAppSec Cloud application using the static app endpoint `/waf/apps/{ep_id}/http_header_security`. Set `template = false` and provide `configs` to manage settings directly. Set `template = true` and omit `configs` to inherit this module from the application's attached WAF template.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_http_header_security` resource for an application endpoint. Template-level settings are managed by `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_http_header_security`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_http_header_security" "example" {
  ep_id    = fortiappseccloud_waf_app.example.ep_id
  template = false

  configs {
    status                       = true
    content_security_policy      = true
    header_value                 = "default-src 'self'"
    referrer_policy              = true
    referrer_policy_header_value = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    x_content_type_options       = true
    x_frame_options              = true
    x_xss_protection             = true
  }
}
```

## Configuration Notes

- Enabling a response-header control can require its associated value. For example, enable `content_security_policy` together with `header_value` as shown.

## Argument Reference

- `ep_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — Application endpoint ID. Import uses this exact value and it must contain a non-whitespace character.
- `template` (Required) — Whether effective configuration is inherited from the attached template.
- `configs` (Block) — Required when `template = false` and forbidden when `template = true`. State keeps this block null when template inheritance is enabled.
  - `content_security_policy` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Content security policy for HTTP header security. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `header_value` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Header value. At most 1023 UTF-8 characters. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `referrer_policy` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Referrer policy for HTTP header security. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `referrer_policy_header_value` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Referrer policy header value. One of `no-referrer`, `no-referrer-when-downgrade`, `origin`, `origin-when-cross-origin`, `same-origin`, `strict-origin`, `strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, `unsafe-url`, at most 64 UTF-8 characters. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `status` (Optional, Computed) — Enables or disables HTTP header security. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `x_content_type_options` (Optional, Computed) — Controls X content type options for HTTP header security. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `x_frame_options` (Optional, Computed) — Controls X frame options for HTTP header security. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `x_xss_protection` (Optional, Computed) — Controls X xss protection for HTTP header security. Omission preserves the current value.


## Import

Import using the application `ep_id`:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_http_header_security.example application-endpoint-id
```

The first read after import hydrates all ownership wrappers when `template = false`.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
